admin-errors.attendeeArchived.defaultMessage: This attendee is archived and the ticket cannot be used for check-in.
admin-errors.attendeeArchived.description: The attendee is archived, so they cannot be checked in.

admin-errors.attendeeNotFound.description: The attendee no longer exists, for example because another operator removed the record.

admin-errors.audienceInvalid.description: The WhatsApp audience sent is not participants or volunteers. Only a tampered or outdated form reaches this.

admin-errors.invalidAttendee.description: The request did not name a valid attendee. Only a tampered or outdated page reaches this.

admin-errors.itemAlreadyRedeemed.defaultMessage: Cannot remove {item, select, meal {snack} drink {drink} tshirt {T-shirt} tshirt_volunteer {volunteer T-shirt} lunch {lunch} other {item}}: it has already been collected.
admin-errors.itemAlreadyRedeemed.description: Refuses clearing an entitlement the attendee has already collected. {item} is the item, lowercase, as it reads mid-sentence; other is only a fallback.

admin-errors.itemNotEntitled.defaultMessage: This attendee is not entitled to {item, select, meal {snack} drink {drink} tshirt {T-shirt} tshirt_volunteer {volunteer T-shirt} lunch {lunch} other {item}}.
admin-errors.itemNotEntitled.description: Refuses marking an item as collected when the attendee is not entitled to it. {item} is the item, lowercase, as it reads mid-sentence; other is only a fallback.

admin-errors.itemNotRedeemed.defaultMessage: {item, select, meal {The snack} drink {The drink} tshirt {The T-shirt} tshirt_volunteer {The volunteer T-shirt} lunch {The lunch} other {The item}} has not been collected yet.
admin-errors.itemNotRedeemed.description: Refuses undoing a collection that is not recorded. {item} is the item, capitalised at the start of the sentence; other is only a fallback.

admin-errors.leaveNotConfirmed.defaultMessage: Action canceled. Tap again to leave.
admin-errors.leaveNotConfirmed.description: Warning toast shown when an armed two-press control cancels a click on a link or form that would leave the page, so the pending action is not lost silently. The next click leaves normally.

admin-errors.listChanged.defaultMessage: The list has changed. Review it before sending.
admin-errors.listChanged.description: The recipients changed between preview and send; the operator must preview again.

admin-errors.nameInvalid.defaultMessage: Enter the full name, up to 120 characters.
admin-errors.nameInvalid.description: The attendee's name is empty, has no letters, or is longer than the 120-character limit.

admin-errors.optionNotAllowed.defaultMessage: Choose an option from the list for {item, select, meal {snack} drink {drink} tshirt {T-shirt} tshirt_volunteer {volunteer T-shirt} lunch {lunch} other {item}}.
admin-errors.optionNotAllowed.description: An entitlement value (meal option, drink option, t-shirt size, volunteer t-shirt size, lunch) is not on the approved list and is not the value already stored. {item} names the field, lowercase; other is only a fallback.

admin-errors.pauseBeforeRetry.defaultMessage: Pause the run before resending interrupted messages.
admin-errors.pauseBeforeRetry.description: Retrying interrupted sends is only allowed while the run is paused.

admin-errors.phoneInvalid.defaultMessage: Enter the phone number with area code, 10 to 11 digits.
admin-errors.phoneInvalid.description: The attendee's phone has too few or too many digits. The last four digits are the check-in verification code.

admin-errors.phoneMissing.description: The WhatsApp test send was submitted without a phone number.

admin-errors.previewExpired.defaultMessage: The preview has expired. Generate a new one.
admin-errors.previewExpired.description: The preview token expired before the operator confirmed the send.

admin-errors.previewMissing.description: A send was requested without a preview. Only an outdated page reaches this.

admin-errors.reasonInvalid.defaultMessage: Choose a reason from the list.
admin-errors.reasonInvalid.description: A correction arrived without a reason, or with one not allowed for that correction.

admin-errors.redemptionChanged.defaultMessage: The pickup status changed while the page was open. Check it and try again.
admin-errors.redemptionChanged.description: Refuses an undo because the collection was recorded again after the page was opened; the operator must look again.

admin-errors.requestInProgress.defaultMessage: Still processing the previous request. Try again in a few moments.
admin-errors.requestInProgress.description: The same save is still running from an earlier tap, typically one whose answer timed out. Trying again once it finishes shows its result rather than repeating it.

admin-errors.roleInvalid.description: The attendee's role is neither participant nor volunteer.

admin-errors.roleLocked.defaultMessage: The ticket type cannot be changed after check-in is complete.
admin-errors.roleLocked.description: The role cannot change once the attendee has checked in: their arrival number counts for the raffle.

admin-errors.runFinished.description: The run cannot be cancelled because it has already ended.

admin-errors.runInProgress.defaultMessage: A run is already in progress.
admin-errors.runInProgress.description: Only one WhatsApp run may be active at a time.

admin-errors.runInvalid.description: The request did not name a valid run. Only a tampered or outdated page reaches this.

admin-errors.runNotFound.description: The run named no longer exists for this event.

admin-errors.runNotPaused.description: Resume was pressed on a run that is not paused, usually because another operator already resumed it.

admin-errors.runNotRunning.defaultMessage: This run is not in progress.
admin-errors.runNotRunning.description: Stop was pressed on a run that is not running, usually because it already finished or was paused.

admin-errors.scheduleChanged.defaultMessage: Another administrator changed the schedule while the page was open. Reload to see the current version.
admin-errors.scheduleChanged.description: Refuses a save of the pass welcome schedule because someone else saved it after this page was opened. Nothing was changed; the operator must reload and redo their edit.

admin-errors.scheduleDuplicateTime.defaultMessage: Two lines are set for the same time. Each switch needs a different time.
admin-errors.scheduleDuplicateTime.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule in which two entries start at the same date and time.

admin-errors.scheduleInvalid.defaultMessage: The submitted schedule is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
admin-errors.scheduleInvalid.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule whose shape is wrong, such as an unknown phase. Only a tampered or outdated page reaches this.

admin-errors.scheduleTextMissing.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule in which a custom entry has no text, or only spaces and invisible characters.

admin-errors.scheduleTextTooLong.defaultMessage: Custom text can be at most {max, number} characters.
admin-errors.scheduleTextTooLong.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule in which a custom entry's text is longer than the limit. {max} is the limit, a number.

admin-errors.scheduleTimeInvalid.defaultMessage: One of the dates is invalid or falls outside the event schedule.
admin-errors.scheduleTimeInvalid.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule entry whose date and time is malformed, or falls in a daylight-saving gap or overlap of the event's time zone.

admin-errors.scheduleTooLong.defaultMessage: Line limit exceeded. Remove some and try again.
admin-errors.scheduleTooLong.description: Refuses a pass welcome schedule with more entries than the server accepts.

admin-errors.sendingDisabled.defaultMessage: WhatsApp sending is disabled on this server.
admin-errors.sendingDisabled.description: Starting, resuming and test sends are refused while WHATSAPP_ENABLED is off on this server.

admin-errors.templateAudienceMismatch.defaultMessage: This template cannot be sent to this audience.
admin-errors.templateAudienceMismatch.description: The chosen template is not approved for the chosen audience.

admin-errors.templateInvalid.description: The template sent is not a registered one. Only a tampered or outdated form reaches this.

admin-errors.testPhoneInvalid.defaultMessage: Invalid phone number: enter area code and number.
admin-errors.testPhoneInvalid.description: The test send's phone number could not be read.

admin-errors.ticketCodeFormat.defaultMessage: The code must be six letters or numbers.
admin-errors.ticketCodeFormat.description: A typed ticket code has the wrong shape.

admin-errors.ticketCodePrefix.defaultMessage: The code prefix does not match the ticket type.
admin-errors.ticketCodePrefix.description: A typed ticket code's prefix (v for volunteers) does not match the chosen role.

admin-errors.ticketCodeTaken.defaultMessage: This ticket code is already in use.
admin-errors.ticketCodeTaken.description: A typed ticket code already belongs to another attendee.

admin-errors.ticketLimitCap.defaultMessage: The limit must be a whole number between {min, number} and {max, number}.
admin-errors.ticketLimitCap.description: The ticket limit's cap is not a whole number in range. {min} and {max} are the smallest and largest cap, numbers.

admin-errors.ticketLimitMode.defaultMessage: Choose what happens when the limit is reached: block or warn only.
admin-errors.ticketLimitMode.description: The ticket limit's mode is missing or is neither hard (refuses the ticket) nor warn (only warns).

admin-errors.ticketLimitReached.defaultMessage: The ticket limit has been reached.
admin-errors.ticketLimitReached.description: A participant could not be created or restored because the hard ticket limit has no room left. The message carries no figures; the form's banner shows them.

admin-errors.ticketLimitScope.defaultMessage: Choose what the limit counts: off, all participants or only tickets created at the door.
admin-errors.ticketLimitScope.description: The ticket limit's scope is missing or is none of off, total (every participant) or door (only tickets created in the editor).

admin-errors.volunteerOnlyItem.defaultMessage: Only volunteers can be entitled to {item, select, meal {snack} drink {drink} tshirt {T-shirt} tshirt_volunteer {volunteer T-shirt} lunch {lunch} other {this item}}.
admin-errors.volunteerOnlyItem.description: A volunteer-only item was set on a participant. {item} is the item, lowercase, as it reads mid-sentence; other is only a fallback. To change a volunteer holding one to a participant, clear the item first.

admin-errors.whatsappDoorLocked.defaultMessage: Sending tickets by WhatsApp is disabled in the server settings.
admin-errors.whatsappDoorLocked.description: The door WhatsApp switch cannot be changed because WHATSAPP_DOOR_ENABLED or WHATSAPP_ENABLED is false in .env.
